text:
The dentist did a great job and was very attentive. The price was moderate, neither cheap nor expensive. However, I have a few minor complaints: the assistant seemed inexperienced and made several mistakes. Also, the upstairs treatment room didn't look as new and luxurious as the downstairs room, although it was clean. It just wasn't as small and didn't appear as modern as it did from downstairs.

Edit: I went back to get a filling fixed because it had fallen out. The dentist did it for free, but I experienced a lot of tooth sensitivity afterward.😅😅
